the film's maple print: how the winged maple samara is drawn.
style anchor (the film's woodblock print style, palette and paper).
prompt: Make one image as a refined full-colour Jiangnan water-print woodblock print in exactly the style of the anchors: a macro view at ground level. One single winged maple samara lies on dark, moist forest soil in the middle of the frame, its wing curving up to the right, glowing translucent ochre-gold against a low golden backlight from the upper left; the seed end of the samara has just split and the tip of a pale root is starting to come out. Fine crumbs of soil, a few fallen leaf fragments, the background a soft dark green-brown wash with a few round paper-white light spots. Carved ink outlines, flat printed colour, wood grain, xuan paper fibres, no 3D shading. Leave the upper third calm for text. No people, no text, no seals, no signatures.
